basics.name: Yang Zhang
basics.label: Master's Student in Cybersecurity
basics.summary: Master's student at Nankai University focusing on vector databases, AI security, database security, and web security. Experienced in openGauss database kernel development, searchable symmetric encryption, vulnerability analysis, and RAG defense frameworks.

work.summary: Participated in enterprise vulnerability scanning system maintenance and strategy updates.
highlights: Scanned and analyzed common vulnerabilities including SQL injection, XSS, and SSRF.
Developed efficient proof-of-concept exploits for specific logic vulnerabilities.

education.institution: Nankai University, College of Cryptography and Security
courses: Research interests: vector databases and AI security

education.institution: Nankai University, College of Cryptography and Security

publications.name: Web Situational Awareness and User Interaction Behavior Analysis
publications.summary: Security posture analysis of global Top 500 websites using high-concurrency crawling, interface element analysis, and user interaction behavior modeling.

publications.name: Defense Framework Against RAG Data Extraction Attacks
publications.summary: A hidden-state monitoring defense framework for external data extraction attacks in RAG systems, designed to identify attack intent before generation and avoid token leakage.

portfolio.name: Searchable Symmetric Encryption for openGauss
portfolio.description: Implemented SSE encryption operators in the openGauss database kernel with C/C++, supporting transparent encrypted search over sensitive fields.

portfolio.name: RAG Data Extraction Attack Defense
portfolio.description: Built a defense framework against RAG external data extraction attacks by monitoring frozen LLM hidden-state representations before generation.

portfolio.name: Web Situational Awareness and User Interaction Analysis
portfolio.description: Led analysis of global Top 500 websites with Python-based high-concurrency crawlers and interaction behavior modeling.

portfolio.name: Android Application with LLM API Integration
portfolio.description: Developed an Android application integrating database storage, LLM API calls, and UI design for the Nankai University President's Cup.
